patch_description: Add a bounded deterministic perturb-and-repolish phase after normal strict local search. The existing descent can stop at a local minimum where every direct move, swap, and chain is non-improving, despite a slightly worse intermediate placement enabling a better final arrangement. The new phase perturbs only models on a bottleneck GPU using a small number of capacity-safe relocations or swaps, reruns the existing strict improvement routine, and retains a candidate only if it improves the original placement. This preserves feasibility and never returns an inferior solution.
